items.title: Meditations
items.creator: Marcus Aurelius
items.blurb: A emperor's private notes on doing the next right thing under pressure. Short entries; open anywhere.

items.title: The Aeneid
items.creator: Virgil
items.blurb: Duty, detours, and the long way home. For days when the road refuses to be straight.

items.title: Poems of Gerard Manley Hopkins
items.creator: Gerard Manley Hopkins
items.blurb: Sprung rhythm and bright contraries — poems that treat change as the honest subject.

items.title: Metropolis (1927)
items.creator: Fritz Lang
items.blurb: Machines, hearts, and the price of both. A silent epic that still argues with the present.

items.title: A Trip to the Moon (1902)
items.creator: Georges Méliès
items.blurb: The first science-fiction film: playful, handmade wonder aimed straight at the sky.

items.title: Intolerance (1916)
items.creator: D. W. Griffith
items.blurb: Four eras, one argument about patience and its absence. Long, but it earns its length.

items.title: The Planets — Venus, the Bringer of Peace
items.creator: Gustav Holst (perf. Public Domain)
items.blurb: Fifteen minutes of unhurried warmth. Let the day's volume drop a register.

items.title: The Planets — Mars, the Bringer of War
items.creator: Gustav Holst (perf. Public Domain)
items.blurb: For friction days: name the pressure, give it a rhythm, let it move through you.

items.title: The Planets — Saturn, the Bringer of Old Age
items.creator: Gustav Holst (perf. Public Domain)
items.blurb: Time, considered kindly. For days that ask what lasts.

items.title: Nocturnes
items.creator: John Field
items.blurb: Quiet piano for late thinking. The original nocturnes, before the word meant romance.

items.title: On the Origin of Species
items.creator: Charles Darwin
items.blurb: Patient observation changing everything. For slow-transit days that reward looking again.

items.title: Orphic hymns, read aloud (archive recordings)
items.creator: Various, trans. public domain
items.blurb: Ancient addresses to the planets themselves — the sky, spoken to directly.
